column1: # *** THE ACT THAT MAKES GILBERTO A BROTHER, ON A DOCUMENT. ***
# San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo. Folio 504, act No. 1447, 31 October 1886.
# Priest: Martin Perez - the same hand that wrote act 1720 for Candido Jaime that same year.
# Index ark 1:1:6D38-DNHP; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-Z9RM-W. Read 13 September 2026, DeepZoom level 12.
# Until this image was opened, Gilberto's parentage rested on TWO PARISH INDEX ENTRIES, and before
# that on Geneanet, Geni and a genealogical blog. The archive published it as a strong lead and
# refused to call it a descent. *** IT IS NOW PRIMARY. ***

column2: hija legitima de Don GILBERTO LERENA y de Dona JULIA SALVANACH, ORIENTALES
column3: Both stated Uruguayan. The wife's surname is written SALVANACH here; the 1895 Buenos Aires census gave Salvanach and another record Salvancich.

column1: Paternal grandparents
column2: *** "abuelos paternos: Don LUIS y Dona JUSTINIANA LENGUAS" ***
column3: *** THE SAME COUPLE NAMED AS LUIS EUGENIO'S PARENTS *** in his marriage act of 1864 and his death act of 1901. So Gilberto and Luis Eugenio are BROTHERS, and it is now a document that says so rather than a tree.

column1: Maternal grandparents
column2: maternos: Don Cristobal, Dona Angela Alvarez
column3: Julia Salvanach's parents - two new people, never before in this archive.

column1: Godparents
column2: *** "fueron padrinos: Don Rufino Yurramendi y Dona JULIA JUANICO DE LERENA" ***
column3: *** THE GODMOTHER IS LUIS EUGENIO'S WIFE. *** Julia Juanico stood at the font for her husband's brother's daughter. The two households are not merely related on paper; they are one family acting as one.

column1: # *** WHAT THIS SETTLES, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT. ***
# SETTLED: Gilberto Justiniano Lerena Lenguas - co-founder of the Argentine Stud Book, breeder of
# Old Man, the man the Gran Premio Gilberto Lerena was renamed for in 1914 - is the brother of the
# man whose daughter was the single Lerena baptised at Rosario in a hundred and seventy years.
# The horses and the Rosario thread are one Montevideo household, on primary evidence.
# NOT SETTLED, and it is the whole question: this still does not find JUAN CARLOS LERENA, who is in
